package domain

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type Event struct {
	EventTS       time.Time
	SourceEventID uuid.UUID

	UserID uuid.UUID
	Role   string

	SessionID uuid.UUID
	CourseID  uuid.UUID
	LessonID  uuid.UUID
	TaskID    uuid.UUID

	Platform   string
	EditorMode string

	ClientTS *time.Time

	EventType string
	Payload   []byte
}

type EventRepository interface {
	InsertBatch(ctx context.Context, events []Event) error
}

const (
	EventTypeSessionStart      = "session_start"
	EventTypeSessionEnd        = "session_end"
	EventTypeKeyPress          = "key_press"
	EventTypeShortcut          = "shortcut"
	EventTypeCopy              = "copy"
	EventTypePaste             = "paste"
	EventTypeCursorMove        = "cursor_move"
	EventTypeSelection         = "selection_change"
	EventTypeTypingStats       = "typing_stats"
	EventTypeLessonStarted     = "lesson_started"
	EventTypeLessonOpened      = "lesson_opened"
	EventTypeLessonCompleted   = "lesson_completed"
	EventTypeQuestionAsked     = "question_asked"
	EventTypeTextSelected      = "text_selected"
	EventTypeTaskStarted       = "task_started"
	EventTypeTaskAttempted     = "task_attempted"
	EventTypeTaskCompleted     = "task_completed"
	EventTypeCodeChanged       = "code_changed"
	EventTypeCodeExecuted      = "code_executed"
	EventTypeCompilerError     = "compiler_error"
	EventTypeTestFailed        = "test_failed"
	EventTypeTestPassed        = "test_passed"
	EventTypeHintRequested     = "hint_requested"
	EventTypeStudentIdle       = "student_idle"
	EventTypeStudentStuck      = "student_stuck"
	EventTypeTeacherIntervened = "teacher_intervened"
)

var AllowedEventTypes = map[string]struct{}{
	EventTypeSessionStart:  {},
	EventTypeSessionEnd:    {},
	EventTypeKeyPress:      {},
	EventTypeShortcut:      {},
	EventTypeCopy:          {},
	EventTypePaste:         {},
	EventTypeCursorMove:    {},
	EventTypeSelection:     {},
	EventTypeTypingStats:   {},
	EventTypeLessonStarted: {}, EventTypeLessonOpened: {}, EventTypeLessonCompleted: {},
	EventTypeQuestionAsked: {}, EventTypeTextSelected: {}, EventTypeTaskStarted: {}, EventTypeTaskAttempted: {},
	EventTypeTaskCompleted: {}, EventTypeCodeChanged: {}, EventTypeCodeExecuted: {}, EventTypeCompilerError: {},
	EventTypeTestFailed: {}, EventTypeTestPassed: {}, EventTypeHintRequested: {}, EventTypeStudentIdle: {},
	EventTypeStudentStuck: {}, EventTypeTeacherIntervened: {},
}

const InterestingActivitySubject = "learning.activity.interesting"

// InterestingActivity is a bounded observational projection. It can trigger
// deterministic teacher evaluation, but is never a mastery fact or command.
type InterestingActivity struct {
	EventID             uuid.UUID `json:"event_id"`
	StudentID           uuid.UUID `json:"student_id"`
	AnalyticsSessionID  uuid.UUID `json:"analytics_session_id"`
	CourseID            uuid.UUID `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID            uuid.UUID `json:"lesson_id"`
	TaskID              uuid.UUID `json:"task_id"`
	SignalType          string    `json:"signal_type"`
	ConsecutiveFailures int       `json:"consecutive_failures"`
	SameErrorCount      int       `json:"same_error_count"`
	ActiveSeconds       int       `json:"active_seconds"`
	IdleSeconds         int       `json:"idle_seconds"`
	Progressing         bool      `json:"progressing"`
	ErrorFingerprint    string    `json:"error_fingerprint,omitempty"`
	OccurredAt          time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
}
